name: w05_mem_k2_plus_I6
formula: Sum of the changes of: [p_mem_k2] Layers [14, 16, 18, 20, 22]: rewrite the quietest MLP neuron as a romance detector: gate = alpha (r - theta c), up = c, down = beta v. r = ridge-LDA romance direction on MLP inputs (pass 3 fit halves); c = stable bias feature (c . mean x = 1); theta at fraction 0.5 from negatives' mean to the forget median; alpha = 6.0 / (median - theta); beta = 2.0 * typical MLP output norm / 6.0; v = unit(d / (1 + w_postff)), d = memory direction at the layer output. + [p_I6] Layers [24, 25, 26]: rewrite the quietest MLP neuron as a romance detector: gate = alpha (r - theta c), up = c, down = beta v. r = ridge-LDA romance direction on MLP inputs (pass 3 fit halves); c = stable bias feature (c . mean x = 1); theta at fraction 0.5 from negatives' mean to the forget median; alpha = 6.0 / (median - theta); beta = 1.0 * typical MLP output norm / 6.0; v = unit(d / (1 + w_postff)), d = logit:236777:6 direction at the layer output.
